title: Nayla Sol Garcilazo
text:
Bio
I’m a proffessor assistant in graduate and postgraduate at the National University of San Martín, also i’m part of the lab at Computational Social Science Factor~Data and the Center of Study about the Digital Society, from the Interdisciplinary School of Advanced Social Studies.
Primarily i work with R, but at the begining i studied with Python and SQL at the Data Analysis and Public Policy Diploma of the University of Buenos Aires.
Previously, i worked as a public policy and data analyst at the National Weather Service and the National Institute of Statistics and Census.
